prompt: As of 2022, how many Indian states had any political party win more than 50% of the vote in assembly elections exactly twice?
answer:
As of 2022, **six state-level assembly jurisdictions** had a political party cross the 50% vote-share mark in **exactly two** assembly elections.

This count treats Delhi/NCT as a state-level assembly jurisdiction, as in the election dataset, and counts only individual parties—not alliances. Excluding Delhi on the strict constitutional definition of “state” would make the count **five**.
